title: ReFresca
body:
This is a smallish resource pack that retextures the Strawberry Bush crops from TeamAbnormals' [Neapolitan](https://modrinth.com/mod/neapolitan) mod; strawberries themselves as well as all other strawberry-related items (scones, sacks, seeds, cake) are unchanged.

This was origninally made for the [Resurvival Modpack](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/resurvival), but I have gotten permission to re-upload it as a separate project.

*This pack is not an official TeamAbnormals project.
